title: Intraoperative Antegrade Bowel Lavage for Ileostomy-Reversal vs. Standard-Ileostomy-Reversal – a prospective randomized multicenter trial
summary: To compare the standard ileostomy reversal (S-IR) with ileostomy reversal with bowel lavage (ABL-IR). The study hypothesis is, that postoperative bowel paralysis/bowel obstruction appears less frequently in the treatment group with antegrade bowel lavage compared to the standard ileostomy reversal

interventions.name:
Experimental intervention:
Ileostomy reversal with intraoperative antegrade bowel lavage (100 ml NaCl 0.9% or balanced cristalloids-solution (e.g. lactated Ringer’s solution) (ABL-IR) of the aboral intestinal loop before anastomotic reconstruction of the intestinal continuity.

Control intervention:
Standard-Ileostomy reversal (S-IR) without bowel lavage

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient with protective loop-ileostomy scheduled for ileostomy reversal due to benign or malign underlying disease, Patient’s age ≥ 18 years, 	Ability to understand the study and to participate in the trial examinations, ECOG-Performance-Status 0-2, Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Simultaneous colon-, liver-, peritoeneal-, or multivisceral resection planned, Early stoma reversal (<28 days after initial operation), Pregnant women and nursing mothers, Expected non-compliance of the patient or language problems, Persons with any kind of dependency on the principal investigator or employed by the sponsor or principal investigator, Legally incapacitated persons or persons held in an institution by legal or official order
